summary: Aroostook County, ME: former lookout site west of Ashland. The register says local sources had the old wooden tower standing in 1998; no build date or current status found.

facts.design: Very old wooden tower, per the register; no height or build date given
facts.status_note: The register says local sources reported the tower still standing in 1998. No later source was found.

events.note: Local sources said the wooden tower was still standing (a secondhand report, not verified)
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on September 15, 2008, nominated by Bob Spear

evidence.supports: location: along the American Realty road west of Ashland at the 22 mile marker
evidence.quote: This tower was located along the American Realty road west of Ashland, Maine at the 22 mile marker.

evidence.supports: very old wooden tower; said to be still standing as of 1998 per local sources
evidence.quote: The very old wooden tower was said to be still standing as of 1998, according to local sources in the area.

evidence.supports: the register is the Former Fire Lookout Sites register

corrections.proposed: unknown (register reports a 1998 local claim that the tower was standing)
corrections.why: The only source is the register. It reports a 1998 local account that the wooden tower still stood and does not say it was removed.

notes_for_editor: Single source: the firetower.org/FFLOS entry. The Forest Fire Lookout Association Maine list (https://firelookout.org/lookouts/us/me/) has no Mud Pond entry. Two web searches turned up nothing more on this tower. The brief's status 'gone' is not supported by any source read; the story reports the 1998 local account instead. No access, staffing, fire or build-date evidence found.
